runtime.name: omp
runtime.configuration: Final hardened fixture plus generated poteto-mode and interrogate Skills and reviewer/synthesizer roles in a disposable Git repository; cursor/default; print mode; asynchronous task support; no extensions or rules.
runtime.permissionProfile: read-only workflow with auto-approved read, bash, and task tools

assertions.evidence: The root read the generated repository Skills and OMP role files; no installed cache participated.
The root loaded poteto-mode and selected interrogate for the bounded adversarial design review.
The root read all three files and recorded the expected SHA-256 values before spawning reviewers.
One task call started ReviewerA and ReviewerB before the root attempted to read either result.
The persisted task call contains two byte-identical 5,029-character assignments with all three literal files, hashes, decision question, and output contract.
Print mode ended the root turn while both reviewers were still running, disposing both sessions with Request was aborted before either could yield a complete result.
Both generated reviewer roles exposed only read, grep, glob, and yield; the fixture stayed clean.
No synthesizer was started because neither reviewer produced a frozen result.
ReviewerA and ReviewerB remained named, but no complete attributable review result was available to freeze.
No complete two-reviewer synthesis or root decision was produced.
The root did not reach its required reread, hash comparison, verifier, and independent decision.
The run did not declare or apply a root-session liveness fallback for asynchronous task completion.
External inspection found the disposable repository clean and unchanged.
No commit, push, pull request, or other publication occurred.

limitations: The failure isolated an OMP print-mode lifecycle boundary: a progress-only root final disposes still-running task sessions.
The passing rerun keeps the same fixture and complete initial assignments but explicitly keeps the root session alive while the asynchronous children finish.
OMP delivery remains D0 overall because the separate plugin-manager D1 gate is unresolved.
